simp.text: 有的人忙著插漂亮的花。

trad.text: 有的人忙著插漂亮的花。
trad.bpmf: 有的人忙著插漂亮的花。

example.en: Some people were busy arranging pretty flowers.
There was fragrant, savory meat.
A-Xiang's hand was especially fast.

simp.text: 他先画了一个圆圆的小头。

trad.text: 他先畫了一個圓圓的小頭。
trad.bpmf: 他先畫了一󠇡個󠇡圓圓的小頭。

example.en: First he drew a round little head.

simp.text: 每个人在地上画一条蛇。

trad.text: 每個人在地上畫一條蛇。
trad.bpmf: 每個󠇡人在地上畫一󠇢條蛇。

example.en: Each person draws a snake on the ground.
A snake never had feet in the first place.
This pot of wine doesn't look like much.

simp.text: 他们在大厅里摆好大桌子。

trad.text: 他們在大廳裡擺好大桌子。
trad.bpmf: 他們在大廳裡擺好大桌子󠇡。

example.en: They set out a big table in the hall.

simp.text: 昭老爷家是一栋大大的房子。

trad.text: 昭老爺家是一棟大大的房子。
trad.bpmf: 昭老爺家是一󠇡棟大大的房子󠇡。

example.en: Old Master Zhao's home was a great big house.
There was round, plump fruit.
There was steaming hot rice.

simp.text: 最后加上一条尖尖的尾巴。

trad.text: 最後加上一條尖尖的尾巴。
trad.bpmf: 最後加上一󠇢條尖尖的尾巴。

example.en: Last, he added a pointed little tail.
A-Xiang's eyes lit up.
His nose drew close to the mouth of the pot.

simp.text: 六根小树枝，一起在地上动了起来。

trad.text: 六根小樹枝，一起在地上動了起來。
trad.bpmf: 六根小樹枝，一󠇢起在地上動了起來。

example.en: Six little tree branches began to move together on the ground.

simp.text: 这些人通常被叫做门客。

trad.text: 這些人通常被叫做門客。
trad.bpmf: 這些人通常被叫做門客。

example.en: These people were usually called retainers.
Together they made offerings to their ancestors.

simp.text: 谢谢祖先保佑大家平安。

trad.text: 謝謝祖先保佑大家平安。
trad.bpmf: 謝謝祖先保佑大家平安。

example.en: Thank the ancestors for blessing and protecting everyone.
He felt everyone had worked very hard.
This way is the fairest.

simp.text: 于是大家都点头答应了。

trad.text: 於是大家都點頭答應了。
trad.bpmf: 於是大家都點頭答󠇡應󠇡了。

example.en: So everyone nodded and agreed.
A-Xiang is really impressive.
Smugly, he raised his head.

simp.text: 绝对会惊讶到下巴掉下来。

trad.text: 絕對會驚訝到下巴掉下來。
trad.bpmf: 絕對會驚訝到下巴掉下來。

example.en: They would surely be so surprised their jaws would drop.
He opened his mouth, wanting to talk back.
In his heart he felt both sad and full of regret.
He himself felt guilty inside too.

simp.text: 得意洋洋地走回自己的位子上。

trad.text: 得意洋洋地走回自己的位子上。
trad.bpmf: 得意洋洋地󠇡走回自己的位子󠇡上。

example.en: Triumphantly he walked back to his own seat.

simp.text: 我为什么要多此一举，给蛇加上脚呢？

trad.text: 我為什麼要多此一舉，給蛇加上腳呢？
trad.bpmf: 我為󠇡什麼要多此一󠇢舉，給蛇加上腳呢？

example.en: Why did I have to do something so unnecessary and add feet to the snake?

vocab.en: drawing a snake and adding feet (ruining it by overdoing)

simp.text: 这个故事叫做画蛇添足。

trad.text: 這個故事叫做畫蛇添足。
trad.bpmf: 這個󠇡故事叫做畫蛇添足。

example.en: This story is called 'drawing a snake and adding feet.'
